instructions.text: 50g Low-Fat Greek/Plain Yoghurt 60g Strawberries 10g Honey Extra Cinnamon & Sweetener (Optional)
In a bowl, whisk together the egg, egg whites, sweetener, vanilla essence, salt, and cinnamon.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly spray with cooking spray.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, coating both sides well.
Place the soaked bread into the pan and cook for a few minutes on each side until golden brown.
Transfer to a plate and top with yoghurt, sliced strawberries, and a drizzle of honey.
